name: give-me-doc
description: Convert AI chat to Word documents — powered by Pandoc WASM

scripts.build:extension: vite build --mode extension-content && vite build --mode extension-worker && vite build --mode extension
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:icons && pnpm build:templates && pnpm build:userscript && pnpm build:extension && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs firefox && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs chrome
scripts.release: node -e "const v=process.argv[1];if(!v){console.error('Usage: pnpm release <version>  (e.g. pnpm release 1.0.1)');process.exit(1)};const t='v'+v;require('child_process').execSync('git tag '+t+' && git push origin '+t,{stdio:'inherit'})" --
